name: Staff of Striking

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Striking
powers.text: Arm it: your next hit with the staff spends up to 3 charges, an extra 1d6 Force each.

summary: +3 quarterstaff; on a hit, spend up to 3 charges for an extra 1d6 Force each.
text: A magic Quarterstaff with +3 to attack and damage rolls and 10 charges. When you land a melee hit with it, you can spend as many as 3 charges, adding 1d6 Force damage per charge spent. It regains 1d6 + 4 charges every dawn. If the last charge is spent, roll 1d20; on a 1, it becomes an ordinary nonmagical Quarterstaff.
